review_rule: Only records with readable primary text, local hash, and page-level evidence summaries are VERIFIED.

cases.matter: Phillips Petroleum Company Venezuela Limited and ConocoPhillips Petrozuata B.V. v. Petróleos de Venezuela, S.A.
cases.document_scope: 102-page Final Award; the PDF title and contents identify the Petrozuata and Hamaca projects, claims, conclusions, damages, interest, and costs.

evidence_summary.fact: The award concerns Petrozuata and Hamaca project agreements and PDVSA guarantees.
The tribunal fixed Claimant 2's nominal losses at USD 38,500,000 and updated losses at USD 66,876,773.81 as of 15 September 2012.
The respondent was ordered to pay Claimant 2 USD 66,876,773.81 plus interest.
The tribunal rejected Claimant 1's claim for USD 102,910,000.
Arbitration costs were fixed at USD 820,000 and allocated equally; each side bore its own legal costs.

cases.balance_sheet_use: Record as a commercial arbitration liability/claim with separate rejected claim and costs. Do not combine with the separate ICSID ConocoPhillips investment arbitration or enforcement matters.
overlap_notes: This is distinct from ICSID ARB/07/30 and from later enforcement proceedings.
The award amount is not current PDVSA debt outstanding without payment and settlement reconciliation.
missing_next_records: ICC procedural record and payment history
